Notes. The slitmask name N10 indicates the objects presented in Newman et al. (2010), and the field in which they were observed is given in parentheses. sigma_e is the velocity dispersion within one effective radius, calculated using Equation (2). The effective radius R_e, Sersic index n and axis ratio q are measured in the F160W band. We estimate the observational uncertainty on R_e to be 10%. The dynamical masses M_dyn are calculated using Equation (3).
a The structural parameters for these objects are measured in the F814W band instead of F160W.
b Objects detected in the X-ray.
